title: RPHA 1N Black

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: The HJC RPHA 1N Black is designed to deliver razor-sharp aerodynamics in a chin-on-tank tuck, purpose-built for riders demanding uncompromising high-speed aerodynamic stability and track-certified protection. Built around a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell weighing 1446g, its multi-density EPS matrix is aerodynamically sculpted to isolate cabin noise to ~92 dB while dissipating kinetic impact forces across DOT, ECE 22.06, FIM benchmarks. Inside, 3D laser-cut cheek pads tailor naturally to an Intermediate Oval profile with dedicated eyewear relief channels, secured by track-proven Double D-Ring retention for confident all-day riding.

product_details.description: FIM homologated racing helmet available to the public.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for aggressive track tuck; may feel tight on larger heads due to narrow cheek pads.

technical_analysis: Features Premium Integrated Matrix (P.I.M. Plus) carbon and carbon-glass hybrid fabric shell structure paired with RapidFire II visor replacement system with 2D flat race shield and dual locking mechanism. The interior utilizes ACS Advanced Channeling Ventilation System with Multicool anti-bacterial temperature-regulating interior with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the HJC RPHA 1N Black: combining South Korea 🇰🇷 craftsmanship with RapidFire II visor replacement system with 2D flat race shield and dual locking mechanism and ACS Advanced Channeling Ventilation System with Multicool anti-bacterial temperature-regulating interior. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: HJC RPHA 1N Black: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the HJC RPHA 1N Black. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Intermediate Oval heads.

qualitative_intelligence.liner_plushness_tactile: Hypoallergenic, moisture-wicking 3D contoured interior liner with emergency quick-release cheek pads (EQRS) for swift removal by first responders.
qualitative_intelligence.visor_optical_clarity: Class 1 Distortion-Free Optically Correct shield with Pinlock 120 MaxVision anti-fog lens insert included.

Lightweight shell construction reduces neck strain on long rides
Plush, fully removable and washable antimicrobial cheek liners
real_world_cons: Snug race-contour cheek pads require 2-3 rides for break-in

ergonomic_features.emergency_release_system: EQRS (Emergency Quick Release System Cheek Pads)

introduction: Positioned in HJC's Track / Race lineup, the RPHA 1N Black brings South Korean engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.06, FIM track safety.
story:
The HJC RPHA 1N Black represents HJC's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~92 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan Track / Race helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the HJC RPHA 1N Black delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
